# 10-Week Beginner Spanish Plan for A1

A practical 4-hours-per-week plan built for a working adult, with sessions kept under 30 minutes. The pacing focuses on steady A1 progress: greetings, everyday vocabulary, basic grammar, listening, speaking, and review.

## A1 Progress Chart and Weekly Schedule

### Progress Chart
- Weeks 1-2: Core survival phrases, pronunciation, numbers, and personal info
- Weeks 3-4: Present tense basics, articles, gender, and simple questions
- Weeks 5-6: Daily routines, time, food, directions, and short conversations
- Weeks 7-8: Past exposure, travel basics, shopping, and comprehension practice
- Weeks 9-10: Consolidation, mock A1 tasks, and fluency with common patterns

### Weekly Schedule Table
| Week | Focus | 4-Hour Breakdown | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Getting started | 4 x 25 min: alphabet/pronunciation; greetings; numbers; self-introduction | Say hello, spell name, share basic personal info |
| 2 | Core vocabulary | 4 x 25 min: family; days/months; countries/nationalities; common objects | Understand and use simple nouns with confidence |
| 3 | Present tense basics | 4 x 25 min: subject pronouns; ser/estar; regular verbs; mini-dialogues | Build simple sentences about identity and location |
| 4 | Questions and answers | 4 x 25 min: question words; yes/no answers; articles; gender agreement | Ask and answer basic everyday questions |
| 5 | Daily routines | 4 x 25 min: reflexive verbs intro; routines; time; frequency words | Describe a typical day in short sentences |
| 6 | Food and shopping | 4 x 25 min: food vocabulary; ordering; quantities; polite requests | Handle simple café and shop interactions |
| 7 | Directions and places | 4 x 25 min: places in town; prepositions; asking directions; transport | Navigate simple travel and location tasks |
| 8 | Listening and speaking | 4 x 25 min: short audio; shadowing; role-play; review set phrases | Improve comprehension and spoken response speed |
| 9 | A1 consolidation | 4 x 25 min: mixed review; reading short texts; write short messages; speaking drills | Use common structures more automatically |
| 10 | A1 checkpoint | 4 x 25 min: mock test; weak-area review; conversation practice; final recap | Reach ready-for-A1 performance on core tasks |

### Time Allocation Pie Chart
- Vocabulary: 30%
- Grammar: 25%
- Listening: 20%
- Speaking: 15%
- Review: 10%

## Mobile-Friendly Weekly Rhythm

### Recommended 4 x 25-Minute Sessions
- Session 1: New vocabulary + pronunciation
- Session 2: Grammar pattern + 5 example sentences
- Session 3: Listening practice + repeat aloud
- Session 4: Speaking or writing review + quick self-test

### What “A1 by Week 10” Looks Like
- Introduce yourself and exchange basic details
- Understand slow, clear speech on familiar topics
- Ask and answer simple questions
- Use present tense for everyday needs
- Read and write short messages, forms, and notes

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Start Week 1] https://www.duolingo.com/
- Action: [Button: A1 Practice] https://www.dele.org/
- Action: [Button: Spanish Listening] https://www.rtve.es/play/audios/learn-spanish/

## Sources
- CEFR overview: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- DELE information: https://www.dele.org/
- RTVE Spanish learning audio: https://www.rtve.es/play/audios/learn-spanish/
